author: Reasonable_Use_8915
selftext:
It started as an experiment over a few afternoons, and I can't stop building. It was one level and one monster, now it's seven of each. It's free and runs in your browser, no download, no sign-up.

Since then I've added weather, user accounts, leaderboards, old school gamer tags and more and more graphics detail. It runs great on PC, Mac and tablets, and on mobile it's a completely new experience.

Fable <   
Meshy <   
ElevenLabs <

**Time:** 6hs   
 **Tokens:** about **310 million** for this project -12M dev + rest cache

I'll keep building it, I love it. I play it at night with headphones on the projector, and I get that scare pump every time.

But is it fun for others?

It's called ShadeWick.   
  
Demo Play here 👉 [play.shadewick.com](https://play.shadewick.com/)

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body: u/Reasonable_Use_8915 please update this post with more on how you used AI to build the game. A line saying it was made with AI isn't enough. Share dev details. Rule 4 is there so promotional posts add to the sub by talking about the process and real development. We don't want the sub drowned in empty promotion. Posts that aren't updated may be removed.

comments.author: aigamedev-mod
comments.body:
Please see the requirements for posts about commercial games promotion.

**Game Promotion Posts Allowed, with Requirements**

You must discuss your game within the context of how it was developed using AI. Share with the community and give something for the community to talk about in your development experience with AI. A fire and forget video/image with no text, chatGPT bullet list may be removed by mods. If your game is being sold, you MUST apply the "Commercial Self Promotion" flair.
